articles.title: PM highlights defence, self-reliance and environment in Mann Ki Baat, avoids reference to NEET unrest
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi's monthly Mann Ki Baat broadcast highlighted India's multifaceted progress. He spotlighted growing defence capabilities, significant space achievements, dedicated environmental conservation efforts, and various grassroots successes nationwide. This comprehensive overview underscored India's advancements across critical sectors, projecting a strong image of national development and self-reliance, vital for aspirants to understand the nation's trajectory.

articles.title: Can Neeraj Chopra beat Arshad Nadeem at CWG 2026?
articles.summary: India's Olympic medallist Neeraj Chopra is set for a formidable challenge at the Commonwealth Games athletics stage in Glasgow. He will face reigning Olympic champion Arshad Nadeem from Pakistan in a highly anticipated javelin clash. This competition highlights a significant sporting rivalry between the two top athletes, promising an exciting contest for international athletics fans and medal aspirations.

articles.title: Neeraj Chopra set for blockbuster Arshad Nadeem showdown at CWG
articles.summary: India's Olympic javelin champion Neeraj Chopra is set for a high-stakes international clash in Glasgow. He will compete against Pakistan's reigning Olympic champion Arshad Nadeem and Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage. This marquee event presents a crucial opportunity for India to demonstrate its sporting prowess and national talent on the global stage, fostering competitive spirit among aspirants.

articles.title: India’s drone moment has arrived
articles.summary: Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh earlier this year stressed the urgent need to build a robust domestic drone production ecosystem. This aims to secure India's strategic autonomy and enhance defence preparedness. Such a move is vital for achieving self-reliance in critical defence technology and strengthening national security, positioning India as a significant player in defence manufacturing.

articles.title: China built full-size models of US warships and aircraft to hone its missiles
articles.summary: China has constructed extensive replica sites across remote locations, enabling its armed forces and engineers to rigorously train for potential attacks on Taiwan and U.S. military assets. These mock-ups facilitate realistic simulation of operational scenarios, indicating a focused preparation for potential regional conflicts and bolstering China's strategic readiness against its perceived adversaries.

articles.title: India emerging as trusted global defence partner: PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi asserted India is emerging as a trusted global defence partner, continuously strengthening its capabilities. This underscores the nation's commitment to self-reliance in defence and its growing role in international security, reassuring SSB aspirants of India's robust strategic positioning and indigenous defence growth.

articles.title: India emerging as trusted global defence partner, PM Modi says in Mann Ki Baat
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted India's growing defence capabilities and its emergence as a trusted global defence partner. He emphasized India's commitment to self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) in defence manufacturing, enhancing its strategic autonomy while contributing to regional security. This strengthens India's international standing and ability to address security challenges effectively.

articles.title: India's single malt market hits 5 lakh cases, led by desi brands
articles.summary: Indian single malt whisky is achieving significant global recognition, winning international awards for its craftsmanship and quality. The industry has experienced substantial growth, with estimates indicating a rise to approximately 5 lakh units, showcasing India's increasing presence in premium global markets. This success highlights the nation's economic soft power and ability to produce world-class products, contributing to its international standing.

articles.title: TV guide: the best new shows to watch, starting tonight
articles.summary: A program titled 'In the Opinion of the Censor' on RTÉ One will delve into the historically controversial role of film censorship. Since the enactment of the Censorship of Films Act, the film censor's influence has been a subject of significant public debate. This highlights important national discussions on freedom of expression, media regulation, and societal values, relevant topics for understanding public discourse.

articles.title: A field experiment found working adults randomly assigned to spend $40 saving themselves time, paying someone to clean or run an errand, reported significantly greater happiness than when they spent the same $40 on a material purchase, while a separate study of over 4,000 people found those who said they’d choose more time over more money were consistently happier, even accounting for how much time and money they actually had
articles.summary: The article discusses the common paradox where individuals acknowledge time as non-refundable, unlike money, yet frequently overlook this truth when scheduling. It introduces two studies that financially explored how people truly value and prioritize time versus money. These studies aim to scientifically understand the practical implications of time's irreplaceable nature in our daily lives and decision-making.
